## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle commentary on the *[Smaller Sukhāvatī](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0082)* is by the great Tang Yogācāra-school master [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA) Kuījī (632–682), [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) Xuánzàng's principal disciple. The work presents the Yogācāra-school reading of the Pure Land sūtra, paralleling Kuījī's commentary on the [same sūtra in Yogācāra-traditional format](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0089) (T1758).

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (660 – 682) reflects Kuījī's mature scholarly period.

The Taishō text (T1757) is established on the standard apparatus.
